title: docs: bump npm package versions in the PR that changes them
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- `packages/sdk`, `packages/ui` and `packages/polli-cli` publish only when their version changes; CI skips versions already on npm
- Fixes merged without a bump went unpublished (CLI #16279/#16292, 11 SDK PRs, 16 UI commits)
- Adds one AGENTS.md rule: bump the version (and own lockfile, SDK changelog) in the same PR

gist.headline: A number before takeoff
gist.blurb: A one-line rule gives package fixes their boarding pass: bump the version in the PR that changes the package. Otherwise, npm publishing politely skips them.
gist.summary: AGENTS.md now instructs contributors to bump the version of packages/sdk, packages/ui, or packages/polli-cli in the same PR as a change, along with the package lockfile and SDK changelog where applicable, so publish CI can detect a new version.
gist.impact: Contributors get a clear release checklist for SDK, UI, and CLI changes; this rule does not itself publish the previously skipped fixes.
gist.visual_concept: Show three seed packets labeled SDK, UI, and CLI waiting beside an npm-bound garden cart; Polli stamps a version number on a packet before placing it aboard. Her tiny clerk cap makes the release-process metaphor readable without implying the packages have already shipped.
